catalog.archive_scope: Root repository only; recursive Git submodule payloads are excluded.
catalog.container_strategy: Build the Linux x86 host mode in dev; target profiling or hardware coverage modes require separately admitted host capabilities.
catalog.purpose: Complement AFL++ with sanitizer/coverage-guided compiler and native-program fuzzing.
qualification_gaps: Android submodules in the archive are not needed for the Linux host scope; optional hardware modes still need host qualification.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
catalog.title: Honggfuzz native fuzzing

recipe.dependency_refinement: Four exact original direct system dependencies and their entire 22-DEB closure are private fixed inputs. Original definitions and mapping are retained; no host apt transaction and no claim that unrelated catalog toolchain transitive locks match the host.
recipe.qualification_scope: Linux x86_64 host fuzzing of locally compiled targets; software feedback and crash detection; no perf/PMU/Android/other-platform qualification.

examples.description: Compile a local target using the independently installed instrumentation libraries.
Run a bounded local fuzzing campaign; child ptrace must be allowed by the selected environment.

locations.label: Native tools
locations.purpose: Prefix-relative launchers for the actual compiled ELF tools.

locations.label: Original source and fixed dependency inputs
locations.purpose: Complete unchanged original source archive with a member inventory, original Debian archives, private runtime, licenses and applied-patch evidence.

notes: Original four missing direct system package identities are satisfied by the fixed private closure, not a nearby host version.
The runtime uses its own exact loader and shared libraries; the observed host compiler is used for target compilation.
Only GCC software instrumentation and local child tracing are qualified; hardware counters and Android submodules are outside this profile.
The source material is the unchanged original tar with a complete member inventory; its intentional links to build products remain inside the tar. It is not an expanded source tree.
usage.summary: Run the source-built Honggfuzz host fuzzer and compiler wrapper with the exact private Debian header/library closure.
